knowledge_cards.claim: arXiv:2609.15981 and 2609.17237 are distinct methods and experiments, not versions or independent perceptual confirmations.
Equal source displacement constrains persistent ideal image sources but not missing, spurious, weighted or visibility-changing reflections.
Free-support image-source barycenter is non-convex and initialization-dependent; oracle versus deployable regret is required.
Point-cloud Wasserstein error does not measure rendered timing, amplitude, phase, localization or preference.
Centre/corner asymmetry shows average gains do not imply geometric robustness.
Real MeshRIR reconstruction and simulated MVDR improvement are separate claims and do not transfer automatically to music reverb.
Patch-wise RIR normalization and reassembly require gain, boundary, delay and phase checks.
Stochastic diffusion interpolation needs repeated-seed distributions.
8 kHz and 256 ms validation excludes upper-band behavior and long tails.
One similar EDC/T60 example cannot establish direct-path accuracy, spatial image or preference.
Speech beamforming metrics validate a downstream spatial-filter task, not musical auralization.
Sparse-array geometry must be explicit; one-sided extrapolation is harder than distributed interpolation.
